title: [Bug Fix] #251: Handle GetUserName TryFunction failure during OAuth validation
summary: Fixed OAuth2 SMTP authentication to properly handle token parsing failures by consuming the TryFunction return value, preventing raw errors from being shown to users instead of the authentication-failed message.
key_points: TryFunction return value is now consumed in CheckOAuth2Authentication and GetOAuth2Credentials
Token parsing errors now display the intended AuthenticationFailedMsg instead of raw runtime errors
Same anti-pattern was fixed in GetOAuth2Credentials method
Added regression test for unparseable token scenario
All 49 tests passing including new test
